decisions.reason: This door lever handle family sits squarely in the firm's established architectural hardware knowledge base, so absorptive capacity is high and there is little sign in 2023 that it failed to justify refinement rather than withdrawal.

The mitred door lever handle family is a close design variation on the firm's core offer, making it easy to support with existing engineering, certification and sales channels, which favors retention.

Although the multifunctional door lever handle is somewhat more complex, it still builds on the firm's strong related knowledge in accessibility, safety and integrated hardware, so management would more likely learn and improve than exit quickly.
A standard door lever handle is highly aligned with the firm's in-house manufacturing, ergonomic know-how and coordinated product-family strategy, so the expected response is to keep it in the range.
The door and window handle collection already has visible market validation through a dedicated launch and a 2023 German Design Award, which strongly supports continued commercialization.

The light patinated bronze finish is well within the firm's finishing capabilities and design-led portfolio logic, but as a finish option it is somewhat more exposed to demand volatility than the handle families themselves.
